title: Loud Boom Heard Across Laredo; Police Say No Source Found Yet, Ask Public Not to Tie Up 911
excerpt: Laredo police say they have received numerous calls about a loud boom heard across the community Saturday afternoon, Nov. 14. No source or emergency has been identified, officers and drones are checking the area, and police say there is no immediate danger.
content:
Laredo police say they have received numerous calls about a loud boom heard throughout the community on Saturday afternoon, Nov. 14.

The Laredo Police Department said in a post at 3:44 p.m. that many officers heard the sound as well. At this point, no direct source or emergency has been identified.

Officers are actively investigating their assigned areas, and drones are canvassing the area to make sure everything is all right, the department said. There is no immediate danger, according to police.

Police are asking the public not to call 911 about the loud sound. The department said the lines are being tied up with calls about the sound, and other medical or emergency calls may not be able to get through.

The department said it will post updates with the latest vetted information if there is anything new to share. This is a developing story.

Source: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 14, 2026.
